title:
Epic that handles feature data editing in the Model Scenario interface.

When triggered, this epic:
1. Extracts the feature ID from the action payload using `action.payload.obj.id`
2. Adds the feature to the [current list of plotted features](ModelScenarioApplicationState#selectedItems).
3. Sets `selectedFeatureId` in {@link ModelScenarioApplicationState}.
4. Opens the scenario feature edit side panel.
5. Triggers {@link ModelScenarioPlotChartDataEpic} to plot the feature data.
name: ModelScenarioEditFeatureDataEpic
